Westmere District Council (201901234)

Report of the invented review service

Complaint 201901234

Westmere District Council

5 March 2020

Complaint definition

1. The complaint is about the council’s failure to deal with persistent mould and damp in the property.

Summary of events

2. The resident moved into the bungalow in 2017.

3. Between 2018 and 2019 the resident reported mould on five occasions.

4. The council closed each job without a visit.

Findings

5. In accordance with paragraph 54 of the Scheme, there was severe maladministration by the council in its response to the resident’s reports of damp and mould.

6. There was no maladministration in the council’s handling of the resident’s request to move.

Reasons

7. The council had repeated reports and did not inspect.

8. The council considered the transfer request in line with its allocations policy.

Orders

9. The council is ordered to:

a) pay the resident £1,200 compensation;

b) complete the remedial works within eight weeks.
